categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Touches src/i2p.cpp and modifies outbound I2P connection setup and AddrMan failure handling.
categories.rationale: Eliminating an extra SAM bridge round-trip removes connection latency and fixes unreachable peer error classification in AddrMan. According to the description, passing base32 addresses directly to STREAM CONNECT removes redundant NAMING LOOKUP requests and prevents unresolvable peers from being misclassified as internal proxy errors.
